car.name: Storksbill 1977
car.description: Sandro Munari / Silvio Maiga, 1977 Monte Carlo-winning Stratos HF Group 4 inspiration. Short-wheelbase mid-engine 2.4 V6, rear drive and five-speed manual. Original unbranded 2994 interpretation; event-day setup figures remain estimates.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: 1977 Lancia Stratos HF Group 4, Sandro Munari / Silvio Maiga, Monte Carlo winner. Mid-engine naturally aspirated Dino V6, RWD,5MT. Not Stradale,Stratos Zero,Group5 turbo or 037.

sources.access: Manufacturer winners table explicitly lists1977 Munari/Maiga Stratos HF.
FIA Group4 homologation640 identifies Stratos HF and2418cc; no event-specific gearbox/setup inferred.
Organizer family reference: mid-engine Dino2.4V6,up to280bhp competition,5-speed manual. Not an event-day dynamometer sheet.
Manufacturer confirms Stratos architecture:rear-mid engine,RWD; road-car output deliberately not transplanted.
Group4 manufacturer history:midengineV6,wedge coupe,24-valve versions up to300PS. Not proof of exact1977MonteCarlo tune.

estimates: 280bhp is selected from WRC competition-family reference,not measured1977MonteCarlo output.950kg,200lbft,7800redline,torque curve,140mph and5s0-60 targets are simulation estimates. No unsupported24-valve claim for this exact event.

All individual ratios/final drive,shift/launch behavior,dimensions/tracks/CG,collider geometry,suspension,alignment,aerodynamics,brake bias,limited-slip setup,tank76L and205/65R14 equal tires are approximate game setup,not verified event-day equipment; historic rear stagger is not reproduced.

Original logo-free eight-view body,blank rally dash and gold wheels are2994-inspired interpretation,not replica of sponsor livery or exact cockpit. Live digital gauges,shared steeringwheel and generic sound are gameplay conventions.
Auto Assist uses the five manual ratios for accessibility,not a factory automatic. Native wheel importer only solidifies near-opaque alpha on decoded copy;original PNG retained.
